messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "store in refrigerator between 36ºF to 46ºF (2ºC to 8ºC)"
set: ["store in refrigerator between 36ºF to 46ºF (2ºC to 8ºC)", "store in refrigerator between 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F)", "store between 59°F to 86°F (15°C to 30°C) or in refrigerator for up to 56 days after first use", "store in the refrigerator or at room temperature up to 86°F (30°C)", "store at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C)", "store in refrigerator until first use for FlexTouch single-patient-use pen", "refrigerator temperature is 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C)", "do not store in freezer or directly beside refrigerator cooling element", "store between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F)", "store between 4°C and 30°C (39°F and 86°F)", "store in safe place to prevent stealing or abuse", "if stored in the refrigerator do not allow it to freeze", "store in original bottle", "store at room temperature, 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F)", "pen can be stored in refrigerator", "once at room temperature, do not return to refrigerator"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
